findings.issue: The import block exports and imports more than this public API needs: `public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.NumberField.Cyclotomic.Basic` exposes cyclotomic ring-of-integers/discriminant machinery used only in the proof, `import TauCeti.NumberTheory.EffectiveBounds.QuadraticClassNumber` imports a compatibility path rather than the canonical file, and `import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas` is stale after the basis construction was moved to `Discriminant.lean`.

summary: The declarations are in the right EffectiveBounds area, but the new worked-example file still has wrong import choices: it publicly exports proof-only cyclotomic number-field machinery and imports a compatibility wrapper/stale linear-algebra module.
